WHAT: Timeout asymmetry between FluidAudio and Whisper backends

FLUIDAUDIO: 30s flat timeout (Swift FFI)
- For audio > ~5-10 minutes, CoreML inference will exceed 30s → automatic Whisper fallback
- Audio is cloned (~4MB/60s) before FluidAudio attempt specifically to enable this fallback
- User sees longer processing time but no error

WHISPER: Duration-scaled timeout
- max(60s, 3 × audio_duration_secs)
- 10-minute recording → 1800s timeout
- Handles arbitrarily long recordings

IMPLICATION:
- Short recordings (<5min): FluidAudio fast path works (CoreML ~110x RTF)
- Long recordings (>10min): Always falls back to Whisper (slower but completes)
- Combined worst case: 30s FA timeout + up to Whisper duration-scaled timeout
- If BOTH fail: heartbeat watchdog catches dead pipeline at 30s no-heartbeat

GOTCHA: The edge case table lists a 10-min recording with 'FluidAudio timeout → fallback to Whisper' as the expected path, not an error.
